1.bug_scenario: The bug involves a filterable multiselect component where the focus outline appears on the wrong node when the input is clicked. Instead of the focus outline encompassing the entire control, it only surrounds the input field. This issue is observed in the Carbon Design System version 10.26 on Chrome browser in MacOS.
